name: Novoresume
tagline: The core loop is small enough for a capable coding agent to produce a useful local version in one sitting. For Novoresume, create one-page and multi-page resumes from structured evidence with layout constraints. The hard boundary is templates, content guidance, design polish, and reliable pdf rendering, plus data, distribution, and coaching.
